top_signals.title: US Treasury Five-Year Yields Breach 5% for First Time Since 2007
top_signals.summary: The yield on five-year US Treasuries rose above 5% for the first time in almost two decades as strong US economic data pushed investors to prepare for a series of Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes to stem inflationary pressures.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: US Weighs 90-Day Diesel Export Ban to Tackle Record Fuel Prices: Report
top_signals.summary: The White House is preparing a plan to ban diesel exports for 90 days, Politico reported, citing unnamed sources.

top_signals.title: McDonald's stock falls as it unveils plan to spend big on restaurant upgrades
top_signals.summary: The plans are part of the fast-food giant's new growth strategy, called McDonald's > NEXT.
